text: Free demo: six staff, one haunted hotel, and some of them aren't human.
You might be a normal worker, cooking, cleaning and hunting for imposters.
Or a poltergeist, possessing furniture and dropping chandeliers on people.
Or a doppelganger, disguised as a co-worker until you strike.
Best shot in the trailer: a whole room of floating furniture around a guy reading his paper.
The catch? The running animations look stiff, and it kills the spooky a bit.
The Windows demo is just over six gigs, English only.
Think Among Us meets prop hunt, in a creepy old hotel.
Worth a dip with friends you don't fully trust.
